addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- claude-code-guide: Use this agent when the user asks questions ("Can Claude...", "Does Claude...", "How do I...") about: (1) Claude Code (the CLI tool) - features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, IDE integrations, keyboard shortcuts; (2) Claude Agent SDK - building custom agents; (3) Claude API (formerly Anthropic API) - Messages API for directly passing messages to Claude, Tool Runner (`client.beta.messages.tool_runner`) for running an agentic loop over your own tools, manual tool-use loops, Managed Agents for server-hosted agents with a managed sandbox, prompt caching, and general Anthropic SDK usage; (4) Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) - what it is, setting it up for a Slack workspace, `/install-slack-app`; (5) `claude plugin eval` (writing and running plugin eval suites, its JSON/report, sandbox, CI) and the `/skill-doctor` report. **IMPORTANT:** Before spawning a new agent, check if there is already a running or recently completed claude-code-guide agent that you can continue via SendMessage. (Tools: Glob, Grep, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ArtifactComments, ArtifactData, ArtifactCheck, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- humanize-korean:humanize-diagnostician: 정밀(strict) 모드 1단계 진단 에이전트. 글 전체를 한 번에 보고 "가장 지배적인 AI 티 패턴 3~6개"를 taxonomy ID와 함께 진단한다. 불안정한 span 열거(0↔18개로 요동) 대신 "무엇이 이 글을 지배하는가"라는 안정적 판단을 내려, 후속 윤문 콜이 그 진단을 겨냥하게 한다. 산출물은 02_diagnosis.md 1개. 도구 호출 3회 캡(Read 결합입력 + Read taxonomy + Write 진단). 이 진단이 정밀 모드 품질의 결정 변수다. (Tools: All tools)

- humanize-korean:humanize-finalizer: 정밀(strict) 모드 3단계 마무리 에이전트. 원문과 윤문본을 직접 대조해 ①의미 보존(15항 — 각주·제목·없던 주장 주입 포함) ②자연성(잔존 AI 티 + 과윤문 양방향)을 한 콜로 병합 판정하고, 문제 구간만 국소 보정한다. 전체 재작성 금지 — 의미 드리프트(빈 수사를 없던 주장으로 대체)를 막는 게 존재 이유. 은퇴한 content-fidelity-auditor·naturalness-reviewer 2인을 대체한다. 산출물은 final.md + 09_finalize.json. 도구 호출 4회 캡. (Tools: All tools)

- humanize-korean:humanize-monolith: 전 경로(light·standard·heavy) 공용 단일 호출 윤문 에이전트. 한 호출 안에서 탐지·윤문·자체검증을 일괄 수행하여 5,000자 이하 한글 입력을 2~3분 안에 처리한다. 산출물은 final.md 1개(본문 끝에 `<!-- HUMANIZE-SUMMARY -->` HTML 주석 블록으로 메트릭·등급·자체검증 통합). 도구 호출 chain 3회 캡. 깊은 검증이 필요하면 정밀 모드(진단→윤문→finalize 3콜) 사용. (Tools: All tools)

- humanize-korean:korean-ai-tell-taxonomist: AI가 생성한 한글 글의 "AI 티" 패턴을 체계적으로 분류·확장·버전 관리하는 도메인 전문가. `references/ai-tell-taxonomy.md`를 단일 진실 원천(SSOT)으로 유지하며, 실제 입력에서 관찰된 신규 패턴을 검증해 v1 → v2로 승격한다. (Tools: All tools)

- humanize-korean:korean-translation-scholar: 한국 번역학계(이근희·김정우·김도훈·김순영·김혜영·이영옥·곽은주·조의연)와 국제 번역학(Baker·Toury·Laviosa·Chesterman·Toral·Sarti)의 학술 인용 계보를 Humanize KR 본진 SSOT(taxonomy.md)와 외부 references/scholarship.md 양면에 안전하게 안착시키는 학술 정통성 큐레이터. 보고서의 학술 자산을 본진 분류 체계가 검증 가능한 형태로 흡수하되, SSOT 룰북 슬림성을 해치지 않게 메타필드 + 외부 파일로 분리. 본진 패턴에 출처를 박을 때 호출. (Tools: All tools)

- humanize-korean:post-editese-metric-engineer: Toral 2019 post-editese 3축(단순화·정규화·간섭)을 한국어 정량 지표로 구체화하고, 보고서 8유형 검출 시그널을 metrics.py에 추가해 회귀 검증 가능 상태로 만드는 정량 엔지니어. 표준 라이브러리만, 형태소 분석은 정규식·접미사 사전으로 근사(konlpy·mecab 금지 — v1.6 정책 보존). monolith 외부 사전 처리(prepare_monolith_input.py)에 결합되어 도구 호출 캡 3회 보존. 신규 metric 추가 또는 metric 회귀 검증 시 호출. (Tools: All tools)

<system-reminder>
Available agent types for the Agent tool:
- claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)
- claude-code-guide: Use this agent when the user asks questions ("Can Claude...", "Does Claude...", "How do I...") about: (1) Claude Code (the CLI tool) - features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, IDE integrations, keyboard shortcuts; (2) Claude Agent SDK - building custom agents; (3) Claude API (formerly Anthropic API) - Messages API for directly passing messages to Claude, Tool Runner (`client.beta.messages.tool_runner`) for running an agentic loop over your own tools, manual tool-use loops, Managed Agents for server-hosted agents with a managed sandbox, prompt caching, and general Anthropic SDK usage; (4) Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) - what it is, setting it up for a Slack workspace, `/install-slack-app`; (5) `claude plugin eval` (writing and running plugin eval suites, its JSON/report, sandbox, CI) and the `/skill-doctor` report. **IMPORTANT:** Before spawning a new agent, check if there is already a running or recently completed claude-code-guide agent that you can continue via SendMessage. (Tools: Glob, Grep, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)
- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ArtifactComments, ArtifactData, ArtifactCheck, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)
- humanize-korean:humanize-diagnostician: 정밀(strict) 모드 1단계 진단 에이전트. 글 전체를 한 번에 보고 "가장 지배적인 AI 티 패턴 3~6개"를 taxonomy ID와 함께 진단한다. 불안정한 span 열거(0↔18개로 요동) 대신 "무엇이 이 글을 지배하는가"라는 안정적 판단을 내려, 후속 윤문 콜이 그 진단을 겨냥하게 한다. 산출물은 02_diagnosis.md 1개. 도구 호출 3회 캡(Read 결합입력 + Read taxonomy + Write 진단). 이 진단이 정밀 모드 품질의 결정 변수다. (Tools: All tools)

- humanize-korean:humanize-monolith: 전 경로(light·standard·heavy) 공용 단일 호출 윤문 에이전트. 한 호출 안에서 탐지·윤문·자체검증을 일괄 수행하여 5,000자 이하 한글 입력을 2~3분 안에 처리한다. 산출물은 final.md 1개(본문 끝에 `<!-- HUMANIZE-SUMMARY -->` HTML 주석 블록으로 메트릭·등급·자체검증 통합). 도구 호출 chain 3회 캡. 깊은 검증이 필요하면 정밀 모드(진단→윤문→finalize 3콜) 사용. - omc-reference: OMC agent catalog, available tools, team pipeline routing, commit protocol, and skills registry. Auto-loads when delegating to agents, using OMC tools, orchestrating teams, making commits, or invoking skills.
- typesafe:typesafe-ai: Build AI-powered software with TypeSafe: small units of AI intelligence you can use like programming primitives. Its System One models, including Jev, turn natural language and application state into typed judgments and probabilities that code can combine. Use when a feature needs programmable common sense, when brainstorming what AI could make possible in an app, or when an LLM prompt-and-parse step could become a structured decision. Applications include routing, ranking, extraction, verification, and interactive experiences; these are starting points, not the limits. Read live docs and cookbooks to find useful patterns and discover new combinations.
- humanize-korean:humanize-korean: AI(ChatGPT·Claude·Gemini 등)가 쓴 한글 텍스트를 "사람이 쓴 글처럼" 윤문해주는 오케스트레이터 스킬. 번역투·영어 인용 과다·기계적 병렬·관용구·피동태 남용·접속사 남발·리듬 균일성·이모지/불릿 과다 등 10대 카테고리 85개 AI 티 패턴을 탐지·분류해 내용은 한 글자도 건드리지 않고 문체·리듬·표현만 자연스러운 한국어로 재작성한다. shim의 route_hint(light|standard|heavy)로 경로를 정해 잘 쓴 글은 1콜, 표준은 2콜, 중증·장문만 3+콜(진단→겨냥 윤문→finalize)로 처리한다. 트리거 — "AI 티 없애줘", "AI 같은 글 자연스럽게", "GPT/ChatGPT 문체", "AI 번역투 고쳐", "사람이 쓴 것처럼 윤문", "AI 윤문", "ChatGPT 티 제거", "한글 AI 탐지·윤문", "AI 글 사람처럼", "번역투 제거", "영어 인용 많은 글 윤문", "AI 글 티 안 나게", "휴머나이저", "humanize Korean", "AI detector bypass 한글". 후속 작업 — "특정 카테고리만 다시", "윤문 강도 조정", "장르 바꿔서", "이 문단만", "2차 윤문" 도 모두 이 스킬. 단순 맞춤법·오탈자 교정은 직접 처리, 번역은 번역 스킬, 내용 추가·삭제를 동반한 재작성은 별도 집필 스킬.
- humanize-korean:humanize-scan: 한글 글에 AI 티가 얼마나 있는지 재고, 실제로 고치면 어떻게 되는지 표본으로 보여주는 정찰 스킬. 실측 판별력 상위 6개만 본다. 워크스페이스·진단·게이트·서브에이전트 없이 이 대화 안에서 끝낸다(파일 0개, 서브에이전트 0회). 손볼 게 많다고 나오면 전수 윤문은 humanize-korean(=/humanize)으로 넘긴다. 트리거 — "이 글 AI 같아?", "AI 티 있나 봐줘", "스캔해줘", "윤문 돌릴 값어치 있나", "AI 티 점수", "quick humanize", "/humanize-scan".
- sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj: Analyze a CBO (Customer Business Object) package — discover frequently-used Z tables / function modules / data elements / classes / structures / table types — and save a per-module / per-package reference file so later `program` / `program-to-spec` runs prefer existing CBO elements over new ones.
- sc4sap:analyze-code: ABAP code analysis — size-gated review (one Opus sap-code-reviewer, or Haiku sap-checker detectors + Opus judge for large objects), Haiku evidence check on every finding, then a canned report or a richer briefing on the main thread
- sc4sap:analyze-symptom: Read-only, step-by-step root cause analysis for SAP operational errors. Reads the dump summary and failing source via MCP (known-issue web lookup only when the failure is in standard SAP code), widens to transports and where-used only when the clues call for it, narrows hypotheses with minimal user questions, and provides SAP Note search keywords. Never changes code or data.
- sc4sap:ask-consultant: Direct operational Q&A with a SAP module consultant agent. Auto-routes the question to the matching sap-{module}-consultant and answers against the configured SAP environment (version, industry, country, active modules).
- sc4sap:assist: Business assistant for the connected SAP system — looks up and changes specific documents through the installed business actions (query → preview → user confirm → execute), one confirmed step at a time. Use for requests about concrete SAP data such as open purchase orders, goods receipt, delivery complete, PO release, production order release / confirmation / TECO, sales order create or change, delivery / billing block, post goods issue, billing, FI document display or reversal, payment block, G/L posting, internal order status, cost center actuals, cost repost or activity allocation. Korean requests too — 미결 PO, 입고, 완결, 납기 변경, 승인, 생산오더, 실적 등록, 기술적 완료, 판매오더, 출하 보류, 청구 보류, 출고 전기, 청구 생성, 전표 조회, 역분개, 지급보류, 분개 전기, 내부오더, 코스트센터 실적, 비용 재전기, 활동 배부. Not for how / why / configuration questions (ask-consultant).
- sc4sap:cbo-relation-map: Draw how the customer objects of one or more CBO packages relate — one self-contained HTML relation map built from the reference graph of /sc4sap:analyze-cbo-obj (DDIC typing, check tables, search helps, value tables, row types, view bases, plus includes, calls, submits, transactions, reads and writes from source). Overview with the most connected objects, usage and groups of related objects; a search-driven neighbourhood view drawn like Obsidian's graph (relation presets, filters by kind / type / basis / usage / package); impact of a change up to the TCodes; shortest paths; a table CRUD tab; source lines behind every relation; PNG / CSV export. Customer (Z / Y / namespace) objects only. Collects the graph itself when it is missing (whole package or used TCodes only; eco = map-only collection).
- sc4sap:compare-programs: Business-angle comparison of 2–5 ABAP programs that share the same business scenario but diverge by module (MM vs CO), country (KR vs EU), persona (controller vs warehouse), or time horizon — one editable, versioned HTML report (verdict matrix, field differences, screens side by side, decision guide) plus an English companion. Reader = functional consultant.
- sc4sap:config-to-document: Document one module's configuration as it is in the connected SAP system — one HTML file that follows the module's IMG tree, shows every IMG activity with its real table values drawn on an SM30-style screen, marks the rows customer transports changed (with the transport history), runs configuration checks and adds SAP's own IMG documentation. MM first; other modules through the same pipeline.
- sc4sap:create-object: ABAP object creation workflow — confirm transport+package, auto-create and activate
- sc4sap:create-program: Create ABAP programs (Report/CRUD/ALV/Batch) with Main+Include structure, OOP or Procedural, and full agent-driven coding/QA pipeline
- sc4sap:eco: Run one sc4sap skill in eco cost mode (cheaper sub-agent models and effort, lower main-thread effort; same deliverable as standard) without changing preferences — `/sc4sap:eco <skill> <args>`. Also re-applies low effort on continuation turns of an eco run (`--attach`).
- sc4sap:interface-mapping-spec: Write an interface mapping specification as one editable HTML page in the classic template layout — cover, revision history, header, Source → Target field grid with conversion rules and MAPPING, optional synchronous response block, extraction condition, field guide. SAP side read from DDIC (table, structure, view, function module) or, for new interfaces, from a field list or the module consultant's proposal; non-SAP side proposed; in-page checks; versioned; English companion.
- sc4sap:mcp-setup: Guide to install and configure the abap-mcp-adt-powerup MCP server for SAP ADT connectivity
- sc4sap:module-to-process: Map how one SAP module (or a process area of several modules) runs in the connected system — one HTML page for a module consultant starting a project (conversion, enhancement, AMS takeover). Walks every CBO package of the module, lays the CBO programs onto the standard process backbone (L1 mega process > L2 process chain > L3 process > L4 task, with variants), and writes a BPH table plus one task sheet per L4 (owner, system, business rules with source lines, steps, related standard / CBO / enhancement objects with usage, interfaces, conversion notes). Replaces package-to-process.
- sc4sap:package-to-process: Replaced by /sc4sap:module-to-process (one release redirect). Business-process documentation of custom packages now runs per module, only on the TCodes users actually use, into one editable HTML process map. Invoking this skill hands the request over to module-to-process with the given package(s) as scope.
- sc4sap:program-to-manual: Write an end-user manual (one self-contained HTML file) for one ABAP program — scenario-by-scenario steps drawn on selection / ALV / popup screen mockups with numbered callouts, check points derived from the source validations, field reference, messages with actions, glossary and revision history. Web document on screen, one step per A4 landscape page in print.
- sc4sap:program-to-spec: Reverse-engineer an ABAP program into a Functional/Technical Specification artifact (Markdown, HTML, and/or Excel — any combination). Socratic scope narrowing from "everything" to "only what the user needs".
- sc4sap:project-dashboard: SAP project management dashboard for PMs and the PMO — one editable HTML page per project (summary, KPIs, milestones with Q-gates, WBS with Gantt, SAP actuals, team, history) plus a portfolio page over every project. Templates for new implementation (SAP Activate), S/4 conversion, rollout, AMS release and small projects; module consultant and development consultant tracked separately (WRICEF stages and hand-off queue); actuals read from the connected SAP system (transport requests split into customizing vs workbench, package objects, inactive objects, dumps after go-live). Team members join and leave by date; open items of leavers are flagged and reassigned.
- sc4sap:role-matrix: SAP role & authorization document for a project — one editable HTML workbook (cover with checks, business roles, technical PFCG roles, business role × T-code matrix F/C/D, user × role assignment, authorization objects, SoD rules with automatic conflict check, change history). New design (module consultant proposes roles, T-codes, authorization objects and SoD rules; T-codes narrowed to the ones users run when ST03N usage is available) or read from the connected SAP system (PFCG roles, T-codes, authorization values, org levels, user–role assignment by user ID). - sc4sap:project-dashboard: SAP project management dashboard for PMs and the PMO — one editable HTML page per project (summary, KPIs, milestones with Q-gates, WBS with Gantt, SAP actuals, team, history) plus a portfolio page over every project. Templates for new implementation (SAP Activate), S/4 conversion, rollout, AMS release and small projects; module consultant and development consultant tracked separately (WRICEF stages and hand-off queue); actuals read from the connected SAP system (transport requests split into customizing vs workbench, package objects, inactive objects, dumps after go-live). Team members join and leave by date; open items of leavers are flagged and reassigned.
- sc4sap:role-matrix: SAP role & authorization document for a project — one editable HTML workbook (cover with checks, business roles, technical PFCG roles, business role × T-code matrix F/C/D, user × role assignment, authorization objects, SoD rules with automatic conflict check, change history). New design (module consultant proposes roles, T-codes, authorization objects and SoD rules; T-codes narrowed to the ones users run when ST03N usage is available) or read from the connected SAP system (PFCG roles, T-codes, authorization values, org levels, user–role assignment by user ID). Spreadsheet-style editing in the browser, CSV per sheet, versioned.
- sc4sap:sap-doctor: Diagnose SC4SAP plugin health, MCP server connectivity, and SAP system connection (renamed from `doctor` to avoid conflict with Claude Code's built-in `/doctor`)
- sc4sap:sap-option: View SAP system status snapshot and edit values in `.sc4sap/sap.env` (connection, blocklist), HUD usage limits in `~/.claude/settings.json` → `env`, the agent model-dispatch mode and cost mode (standard / eco) in `~/.sc4sap/preferences.json`, and the SAP screen-mockup theme in the profile `config.json` — single entrypoint for all sc4sap runtime options
- sc4sap:setup: Plugin setup — detect legacy single-profile state (migrate → multi-profile), create or register a SAP connection profile under ~/.sc4sap/profiles/<alias>/, install abap-mcp-adt-powerup MCP server, optionally install DEV-only ZMCP_ADT_UTILS + ZCL_S4SAP_CM_* ALV OOP handlers (tier-gated), register both PreToolUse hooks (blocklist + tier-readonly-guard), optional SPRO / customizations extraction
- sc4sap:smartform-from-pdf: Build a SmartForm from a PDF of the printed form (or a screenshot) — windows, ruled grids as templates, texts in the fonts of existing SmartStyles, then fields, interface and item tables decided with the user — upload it to the DEV system, print it there and score the print against the source page.
- sc4sap:smartform-preview: Draw the expected print of a SmartForm as a JPG (plus the HTML it is drawn from) — windows at their real mm positions, SmartStyle fonts, template / table grids with borders and shading, SE78 graphics such as logos and signatures, loops with sample rows — with invented sample values in place of the &fields&, sized to the real field types. - sc4sap:trust-session: INTERNAL-ONLY permission bootstrap. Pre-approves Agent dispatch + `.sc4sap/` state-file I/O for the session so parent-skill pipelines run without prompts. SAP MCP handlers are auto-approved by the `permission-approver` PreToolUse hook (except GetTableContents / GetSqlQuery, which stay prompt-gated). MUST be invoked by a parent skill (create-program, setup, team, analyze-*, create-object) — direct user invocation is rejected with a redirect message.
- frontend-design:frontend-design: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.
- cowork-plugin-management:cowork-plugin-customizer: Customize a Claude Code plugin for a specific organization's tools and workflows. Use when: customize plugin, set up plugin, configure plugin, tailor plugin, adjust plugin settings, customize plugin connectors, customize plugin skill, tweak plugin, modify plugin configuration.
- cowork-plugin-management:create-cowork-plugin: Guide users through creating a new plugin from scratch in a cowork session. - dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- artifact-design: Design guidance and fundamentals for Artifacts. - Load before writing any artifact, including a skill-instructed Markdown one - Markdown is never a shortcut past the design pass.
- artifact-diagramming: Diagramming know-how for Artifacts - when a picture earns its place, how to draw one that shows the real mechanism, and the inline-SVG mechanics that keep it legible in both themes.

Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. - code-review: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs (plus reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups where the model's recipe covers them) at the effort level given first, before any target (low|medium|high|xhigh|max: from few high-confidence findings to many, some uncertain; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.

Opens pages in new tabs within your existing Chrome session. Requires site-level permissions before executing (configured in the extension). - When the user wants to interact with web pages, automate browser tasks, capture screenshots, read console logs, or perform any browser-based actions. # sc4sap workspace — development rules

Workspace for the sc4sap stack. Each repo has its own CLAUDE.md. `sc4sap/CLAUDE.md` is the plugin's SAP runtime rule index, not developer instructions — do not add dev notes there.

## Repos and where to edit

| Repo | Source of truth | Remote / branch |
|---|---|---|
| sc4sap plugin | `sc4sap/` | origin `active` (shared) → PR → `main`; private remote `enterprise` |
| MCP server | `~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/abap-mcp-adt-powerup/` | origin |
| sc4sap_hanta | `sc4sap_hanta/` | separate marketplace `sc4sap-hanta` |
| sc4sap_web | `sc4sap_web/` | shared repo (PoC clone) |

- Never edit `sc4sap/vendor/abap-mcp-adt/` — it is a generated clone.
- Plugin runtime = cache folder named by `installPath` in `~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json`. Sync project → marketplace → that cache folder, then `diff`.
- MCP fixes run only after `dist/` is copied into the cache's `vendor/abap-mcp-adt/dist/` and Claude Code is fully restarted.

## Verify before saying done

| Repo | Commands (all must pass) |
|---|---|
| sc4sap | `node scripts/bundle-keyring.mjs --verify && node scripts/bundle-keyring.mjs --check && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run test:run` (= CI gate) |
| MCP | `npx jest --testPathIgnorePatterns=integration --testPathIgnorePatterns=admin --testPathIgnorePatterns=/dist/` + `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit`. Never plain `npm test` — it writes to SAP. |
| sc4sap_web | `npm run typecheck` (no unit tests yet — backlog in `PENDING_TESTS_WEB.md`) |

- Show the command output as evidence. "Looks done" is not done.
- SAP-side changes: the user checks them in the TCode before the task is closed.
- Before `npm publish`, push to `main` or a marketplace release: `npm pack` → install → smoke test on a real system first.

## Release (sc4sap)

- Bump `package.json` + `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` + both versions in `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` in one commit.
- Update the MCP pin when the MCP version changes.

## Git

- `active` is shared: no force push, no amend of pushed commits; rebase only unpushed commits.
- Never push `enterprise` / `ent-main` to origin; never merge enterprise into origin `main`.
- Commits need an `Entire-Checkpoint: <id>` trailer (`entire sessions list`) — except `sc4sap_hanta` (no trailer, no `entire`).
- Commit or push only when asked.

## Content rules for public repos

- Skill / agent / rule MDs: English only, ≤ 200 lines (README / CLAUDE.md exempt) — split into a companion file.
- Skill MDs dispatch agents as `"sc4sap:sap-<name>"`.
- No company initials, customer system names or customer Z-object names in public docs, CHANGELOG or plugin logic.
- sc4sap = MCP only; haicode / CLI fallbacks belong in sc4sap_hanta.

## SAP safety

- Delete / drop on SAP: ask per call. Never touch SAP standard objects.
- DEV systems: BAPIs allowed for tests; report document numbers.

## Journal (feeds the nightly dream job)

- When a task is finished, parked or blocked, append one line to `tools/dream/journal/YYYY-MM-DD.md`:
  `- HH:MM [repo] what — state — evidence (commit / TR / doc no.)`.
- Nightly `tools/dream/run-dream.mjs` reads journal + transcripts + git and proposes memory changes in `tools/dream/runs/`; nothing reaches memory until `apply.mjs <run> --yes`.

## Context

- Large files — grep or query, never Read whole: `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/FEATURES*.md`, generated `*.html` outputs, `graph.json`, `dist/`, `vendor/`.
- When the topic changes (e.g. design → commit → new feature), suggest `/compact` or a new session.
- Broad multi-file surveys only → Explore subagent; known files → read directly.

- [Feedback: MD 200-line limit](feedback_md_line_limit.md) — skill/agent/rule MDs ≤ 200 lines, split to companion; CI test md-conventions (28ff97c, pushed); global hook removed
- [Feedback: Skill MD files — English-first](feedback_skill_md_language.md) — skills/*/*.md English only, no Korean in prompts/examples
- [User: owns 3-layer SAP MCP stack](user_role_plugin_developer.md) — sc4sap + abap-mcp-adt-powerup + mcp-abap-adt-clients; fix at the right layer
- [Feedback: verify issue hypotheses before coding](feedback_verify_issue_hypotheses.md) — read the code path + one diagnostic + confirm scope first

- [Feedback: Ask before npm (network blocked)](feedback_npm_network_gate.md) — prove npm is needed (offline check) before asking user to switch network
- [Feedback: No customer specifics in public docs / plugin logic](feedback_no_customer_specifics_in_changelog.md) — no customer systems/Z names in docs, ISO codes not HK/SS/LG, detect patterns not one system's Z objects

- [Feedback: Entire-Checkpoint trailer](feedback_entire_checkpoint_trailer.md) — every commit except sc4sap_hanta; `entire attach <session> -f` amends the last UNPUSHED commit only

- [Feedback: Destructive test ops need per-call approval](feedback_destructive_test_preapproval.md) — Delete/Drop on SAP: ask each time; never SAP standard

- [Feedback: SmartForms — UI-visible attrs, Form Painter gate](reference_smartforms_hidden_attrs.md) — patch only visible attrs; SSF_CHECK ≠ Form Painter OK; ref names must exist
- [Reference: SmartForms activation + format lookup](reference_smartforms_activation.md) — STORE(im_active='X'); unknown format = silent skip; formats from form STDSTYLE; active flag 'A'
- [Reference: SmartForms dispatcher actions](reference_smartforms_dispatcher_actions.md) — SSF_* params; unknown JSON fields silently ignored
- [Reference: MCP runtime path](reference_abap_mcp_powerup_runtime_path.md) — bridge runs cache vendor dist; mirror after build:fast
- [Project: sc4sap_web = SC4SAP-PoC clone](project_sc4sap_web_poc_repo.md) — shared repo; plugin_module by upstream diff; web profile HKT-DEV

# sc4sap workspace — development rules

Workspace for the sc4sap stack. Each repo has its own CLAUDE.md. `sc4sap/CLAUDE.md` is the plugin's SAP runtime rule index, not developer instructions — do not add dev notes there.

## Repos and where to edit

| Repo | Source of truth | Remote / branch |
|---|---|---|
| sc4sap plugin | `sc4sap/` | origin `active` (shared) → PR → `main`; private remote `enterprise` |
| MCP server | `~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/abap-mcp-adt-powerup/` | origin |
| sc4sap_hanta | `sc4sap_hanta/` | separate marketplace `sc4sap-hanta` |
| sc4sap_web | `sc4sap_web/` | shared repo (PoC clone) |

- Never edit `sc4sap/vendor/abap-mcp-adt/` — it is a generated clone.
- Plugin runtime = cache folder named by `installPath` in `~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json`. Sync project → marketplace → that cache folder, then `diff`.
- MCP fixes run only after `dist/` is copied into the cache's `vendor/abap-mcp-adt/dist/` and Claude Code is fully restarted.

## Verify before saying done

| Repo | Commands (all must pass) |
|---|---|
| sc4sap | `node scripts/bundle-keyring.mjs --verify && node scripts/bundle-keyring.mjs --check && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run test:run` (= CI gate) |
| MCP | `npx jest --testPathIgnorePatterns=integration --testPathIgnorePatterns=admin --testPathIgnorePatterns=/dist/` + `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit`. Never plain `npm test` — it writes to SAP. |
| sc4sap_web | `npm run typecheck` (no unit tests yet — backlog in `PENDING_TESTS_WEB.md`) |

- Show the command output as evidence. "Looks done" is not done.
- SAP-side changes: the user checks them in the TCode before the task is closed.
- Before `npm publish`, push to `main` or a marketplace release: `npm pack` → install → smoke test on a real system first.

## Release (sc4sap)

- Bump `package.json` + `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` + both versions in `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` in one commit.
- Update the MCP pin when the MCP version changes.

## Git

- `active` is shared: no force push, no amend of pushed commits; rebase only unpushed commits.
- Never push `enterprise` / `ent-main` to origin; never merge enterprise into origin `main`.
- Commits need an `Entire-Checkpoint: <id>` trailer (`entire sessions list`) — except `sc4sap_hanta` (no trailer, no `entire`).
- Commit or push only when asked.

## Content rules for public repos

- Skill / agent / rule MDs: English only, ≤ 200 lines (README / CLAUDE.md exempt) — split into a companion file.
- Skill MDs dispatch agents as `"sc4sap:sap-<name>"`.
- No company initials, customer system names or customer Z-object names in public docs, CHANGELOG or plugin logic.
- sc4sap = MCP only; haicode / CLI fallbacks belong in sc4sap_hanta.

## SAP safety

- Delete / drop on SAP: ask per call. Never touch SAP standard objects.
- DEV systems: BAPIs allowed for tests; report document numbers.

## Journal (feeds the nightly dream job)

- When a task is finished, parked or blocked, append one line to `tools/dream/journal/YYYY-MM-DD.md`:
  `- HH:MM [repo] what — state — evidence (commit / TR / doc no.)`.
- Nightly `tools/dream/run-dream.mjs` reads journal + transcripts + git and proposes memory changes in `tools/dream/runs/`; nothing reaches memory until `apply.mjs <run> --yes`.

## Context

- Large files — grep or query, never Read whole: `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/FEATURES*.md`, generated `*.html` outputs, `graph.json`, `dist/`, `vendor/`.
- When the topic changes (e.g. design → commit → new feature), suggest `/compact` or a new session.
- Broad multi-file surveys only → Explore subagent; known files → read directly.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow.
